mir.text: Hazezon Tamar leads the Jamuraan city-states against Johan, the tyrant of Tirras, who tries to conquer western Jamuraa.

When Johan's forces attack Bryce, Hazezon, aided by Jaeger Ojanen and his sand warriors, leads the defense and halts the attack, and he then seeks alliances with other city-states, including his ex-wife Adira of Palmyra.
He alters the flow of the River Toloron to force Johan's army back, and when Johan besieges Palmyra, Hazezon summons a devastating sandstorm, though Jaeger is killed by a sand wurm.
In the final battle at Efrava, Johan turns Hazezon's spell against him, but Johan dies, peace follows, and Hazezon governs Bryce before leaving to explore the world.
